card.text: M69 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 8,900 parsecs away.

sources.label: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021), Accurate distances to Galactic globular clusters through a combination of Gaia EDR3, HST and literature data, MNRAS 505, 5957; Baumgardt's orbits table, NGC_6637: Rsun 8.9 ± 0.1 kpc
Wikipedia, "Messier 69"
sources.quote: Messier 69 or M69, also known NGC 6637, and NGC 6634, is a globular cluster in the southern constellation of Sagittarius.

introduction.text: M69 is drawn as 318 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.

sources.quote: It can be found 2.5° to the northeast of the star Epsilon Sagittarii and is dimly visible in 50 mm aperture binoculars.
